_comment: Verified historical findings for tools/audit_snapshots.py. Each entry is pinned to the tag's commit and to specific checks, so a moved tag or a different defect on the same tag is still reported. Add entries only for verified history (see docs/release_process.md); never to silence a new release.

exceptions.reason: Tag predates Release Please adoption; it points at the same commit as v0.1.1, where __version__ is already 0.1.1 (the 0.1.0 source predates that commit), and it has no GitHub Release entry.
Tag predates Release Please adoption; it shares its commit with v0.1.0 (the commit that bumped __version__ to 0.1.1) and has no GitHub Release entry.
Tag created (per its tagger date, 2026-07-18) after v0.2.0 was released, on the 'docs: update changelog' commit that descends from v0.2.0; no GitHub Release entry exists.

The v0.2.0 GitHub Release exists, but the tagged commit still declares __version__ 0.1.2; the snapshot was not cut by Release Please (adopted from v0.3.0). Tags are never rewritten; the mismatch is documented instead.
